select.reason: The ShootOut build (level324) carries the four shop interiors only as shells and a few props and lost most of the hall dressing BSG kept in this earlier TeamFight level (passport hall, stalls, floor damage, ground clutter, decals). Import the furnished shops, their door leaves and, inside the decoration box, the whole prop tree (OO/PROPS, VARIANT, PROPSnoCulling) and every projection decal; skip everything level324 already carries (twin objects) but recover the parts a twin lacks (twin_descendants: the car-shadow decals below the baggage carts); the 208 exclude entries drop the 632 units BSG replaced for level324 (the two old scaffold/cover platforms were swapped for the prefab platforms SOO/airpit_construction_ShootOut_01 (2)/(3), plus moved ladders, planters, tarpaulin walls, ramps and nudged sandbags/barricades), so the hall centre keeps level324's cover. Not imported: PHYSIC (inactive in Arena), SOO cover walls (mode layout) and SOO_LOD0/Destroyed_Brick_Wall* (would close the north-east breach). FLOOR_DAMAGE2 is in scope although BSG switched it off in level324. Three level38 SOO cover props under the imported tarp City_Generic_Tarp_01 (1) at (-31.3, -16.7) come along as explicit roots (reserve_woodBox_medium (9)/(10), cardbox_vinyl; 2026-10-18): level324 has neither the tarp nor crates there, so the tarp hung in the air (user report).
